text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no known antidote for nevirapine overdosage. Cases of immediate-release nevirapine overdose at doses ranging from 800 mg per day to 1,800 mg per day for up to 15 days have been reported. Patients have experienced events including edema, erythema nodosum, fatigue, fever, headache, insomnia, nausea, pulmonary infiltrates, rash, vertigo, vomiting and weight decrease. All events subsided following discontinuation of immediate-release nevirapine.
